summary: Alibaba Group Holding Ltd furnished a Form 6-K containing Next Day Disclosure Returns filed with the Hong Kong Stock Exchange, disclosing routine changes in issued shares and treasury shares, including open-market share repurchases on the NYSE between June 22 and July 1, 2026. The repurchases were at prices ranging from USD 11.84 to USD 13.12 per ordinary share. No other special-situation event is described; these are ongoing buyback disclosures under Hong Kong listing rules. The filing maps to a US-equivalent regulation FD disclosure of capital-return activity. What to watch: continued pace of buybacks and impact on share count.
